project.name: agent-harness-kit
project.summary: agent-harness-kit: a zero-dependency Node.js CLI that scans a repository, records harness decisions in .harness/spec.json and generates AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and skills for coding agents.

rules: Zero runtime dependencies: only Node.js 20+ built-ins.
After changing src/render.mjs, src/engine.mjs or templates/, run npm run examples and review the diff in examples/*/expected.
README and docs describe only implemented behavior; copy examples from examples/*/expected, never invent output.
Generated instructions must stay honest: never present an instruction as enforcement or a heuristic as a measured result.
